landing.badge: Design system · deterministic engines · live AI
landing.heroBody: Nexus checks every socket, watt and millimetre while you choose — then hands the whole build to Gemini for an honest second opinion. No guesswork, no incompatible carts.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything a first-time builder wishes they had
landing.featuresBody: Built on the same logic that catches expensive mistakes before checkout — then explained in plain English.

features.compatBody: Sockets, RAM types, GPU clearance, PSU headroom and cooler height are verified as you pick — no surprise reddit threads.
features.aiBody: Describe your budget and workload in plain language. Get a coherent parts list with the reasoning behind every pick.
features.catalogBody: A curated catalogue with real TDPs, lengths and chipset data — not scraped marketing copy.
features.powerBody: Every component contributes its draw. See total watts and the PSU headroom you actually have left.
features.askBody: “Is 32 GB enough for Unreal?” — the advisor knows your exact build and answers in context.
features.shareBody: Every build gets a clean, linkable page so friends can review the spec sheet — even without an account.

landing.stepsTitle: Three steps from budget to boot
landing.step1Body: Budget, resolution and the workload that matters — gaming, AI, editing, or all three.
landing.step2Body: The engine scores every pick against your other components and rebuilds the totals live.
landing.step3Body: Export a share link, compare store prices, and keep the spec sheet handy for your first boot.
landing.ctaTitle: Your next build is 8 parts away.
landing.ctaBody: Start from an empty list or let the advisor draft one from your budget. Nothing leaves your browser until you ask it to.
landing.sceneAlt: An illuminated 3D motherboard with a graphics card installed
